project_goal: Public-domain-first: 0BSD for new original code; CC0-1.0 for new original assets
assessment: Initial source, notices, build-configuration and asset-metadata review. Not a complete rights audit or native-binary bill of materials.
retention_decision: 2026-10-30 maintainer instruction: inventory existing exceptions without replacing dependencies. This preserves existing scope; it does not grant missing rights or authorize wider redistribution.

entries.name: Godot engine and bundled components
entries.declared_terms: MIT for Godot; separate component terms vary with the engine build
entries.origin: External Godot installation; observed build 4.7.2.stable.steam.ed1daf0bf. https://godotengine.org/license/
entries.distribution_boundary: Engine installation is external to the project source package. Any executable distribution bundling Godot must retain that build's engine and component notices.
entries.reason_retained: The project currently runs on Godot. Project-source licensing does not replace the engine's terms.
entries.next_step: Keep engine infrastructure separate in licensing claims; verify notices for each actual executable distribution. Engine replacement is outside the current task.
closure_evidence: Defined source/assets versus runnable-distribution boundary
Artifact-specific engine/component notice coverage or separately authorized engine migration

entries.name: godot-cpp native bindings
entries.origin: Pinned upstream commit d7b6162249ed52796a8301d216c24ee71d68c2bf; BoQsc/godot-cpp-prebuilt release api-4.7-d7b6162-zig. Archive identity is in native_toolchain.lock.json.
entries.distribution_boundary: The build links the prebuilt static library into seven native addon families. The resulting DLLs are distributed with the project; external SDK storage does not remove linked-code obligations.
entries.reason_retained: Current native integrations use the pinned Godot C++ binding API.
entries.next_step: Retain MIT notices and verify per-artifact/package coverage. Assess binding isolation, an additional grant or independent alternatives only in a separately scoped migration.
closure_evidence: Affected source and all distributed DLLs mapped to bindings and notices
Evidence supporting removal or another valid grant before declaring this exception closed

entries.name: Legacy Godot GDExtension C ABI declarations

entries.distribution_boundary: Retained in source archives. The current typed terrain build excludes godot_bridge.cpp; inactive code still retains its source obligations.
entries.reason_retained: Legacy bridge source remains as historical implementation material.
entries.next_step: Preserve the MIT notice. Revisit only on explicit archival cleanup, additional permission or migration; do not relabel the declarations.
closure_evidence: Disposition and rights basis for retained declarations and copies
Verification of affected source-package and legacy-binary coverage

entries.name: Godot logo and splash artwork
entries.origin: Godot main/splash.png; Andrea Calabró, 2017. The source SHA-256 is retained in assets/branding/README.md.
entries.distribution_boundary: Original PNG is retained in source; the boot PNG embeds the artwork plus the TerraForest footer and is used by the game.
entries.reason_retained: The current approved splash preserves Godot's default appearance.
entries.next_step: Keep attribution and the modification note. A new CC0 project-owned splash or a different grant requires a separate decision; the composite cannot be labeled wholly CC0 now.
closure_evidence: Rights-supported disposition of both source and composite artwork
Updated notices and verification of the final splash asset

entries.name: Inherited terrain texture payloads
entries.declared_terms: NOASSERTION: retained note supplies no new license grant
entries.origin: User-supplied terrain textures retained from v0.4.3. Four .trtex payloads contain original PNG/JPEG bytes, including grass, gravel, sand and snow.
entries.distribution_boundary: Runtime terrain payloads and full source archives; renaming image files did not create a license grant.
entries.reason_retained: Existing supplied terrain assets remain unchanged; the current task does not replace them or resolve their underlying rights.
entries.next_step: Obtain the original asset-specific license/rights evidence, or separately authorize independently sourced replacements. Do not expand use on an assumed 0BSD/CC0 basis.
closure_evidence: Identified original files matched to rights evidence, or authorized replacements
Evidence covering derivatives, runtime payloads and the distributed notices

entries.name: Inherited character base and derivative assets
entries.declared_terms: CC0-1.0 is stated for original/derivative work; inherited rights retain their source scope
entries.origin: Supplied FirstPersonLab/Human R11 and Zombie Lab materials. The character notice identifies the earlier Human.realistic.glb and a source hash; the R11 metadata limits its CC0 statement to original edits.
entries.distribution_boundary: Character runtime models, embedded textures, animation derivatives and retained authoring/source packages. GAP-003 is a separate optional asset; LEG-003 covers retained CC0 code.
entries.reason_retained: Current notices preserve a stated CC0 dedication with inherited-provenance qualifications; they are not independent proof of every upstream right.
entries.next_step: Match the inherited model/textures and subsequent derivatives to original rights evidence. Preserve current scoped CC0 statements while that review remains open.
closure_evidence: Documented asset chain with asset-specific licensing evidence
Mapped runtime and authoring derivatives, including embedded resources

entries.name: Original woodland sample assets
entries.origin: Original TerraForest procedural woodland sample, declared 0BSD in the art README. GAP-004 separately records generated grass detail textures.
entries.distribution_boundary: Existing procedural geometry/textures and source authoring material. Generator code already follows the 0BSD code default; this record concerns its existing asset-output grant.
entries.reason_retained: 0BSD assets differ from the prospective CC0 asset default but retain their existing permissive grant.
entries.next_step: Keep existing terms. Any future additional CC0 dedication must identify outputs and be granted by the relevant rightsholders; do not silently relabel them.
